harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «لعلك باخع» is resumptive; «نفسك» is the object of «باخع». The maṣdar «ألا يكونوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), namely the lām.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «فظلَّت أعناقهم» is conjoined to the clause «نُنزل», in the position of the jussive. The preposition «لها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خاضعين», which is the khabar (predicate) of the abrogating verb (nāsikh) «ظل».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «وما يأتيهم» is conjoined to the conditional clause. «ذكر» is the fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The preposition «من الرحمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ذكر», and «محدث» is a second naʿt. «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr). The clause «كانوا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun hāʾ in «يأتيهم»; the preposition «عنه» is attached to «معرضين».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «فقد كذَّبوا» is resumptive, and the clause «فسيأتيهم» is conjoined to the resumptive clause. «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يستهزئون».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The interrogative clause is resumptive. «كم» is the declarative (khabariyya) one, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «من كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كم». The clause «كم أنبتنا» is an object of «يَرَوا», which carries the sense of a verb of the heart, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «إن في ذلك لآية» is resumptive, and the clause «وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين» is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «وإنَّ ربَّك لهو العزيز» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً}; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause «هو العزيز» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن ربك»; «الرحيم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, an object of an implied «اذكر» (remember). «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya) of the calling, and the clause «ائت» is explicative; the clause «نادى» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «قوم» is a badal (substitute). The clause «ألا يتقون» is resumptive, and «ألا» is a particle of offer (ʿarḍ).

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and what follows it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «يُكَذِّبون» is an imperfect verb, accusative by dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi. The clause «يُكَذِّبون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «ويضيق صدري» is conjoined to the clause {أَخَافُ}, and the clause «فأرسِلْ» is conjoined to the clause «إني أخاف».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «ولهم عليَّ ذنب» is conjoined to the preceding clause {أَخَافُ}; the preposition «عليَّ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. The clause «فأخاف» is conjoined to the clause «ولهم عليَّ ذنب», and the interpreted maṣdar «أن يقتلون» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. كلا لا تخف (no, do not fear). The preposition «بآياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «اذهبا», i.e. ملتبسين بآياتنا (accompanied by Our signs). «معكم» is an adverb attached to the khabar (predicate), and «مستمعون» is a second khabar. The clause «فاذهبا» is conjoined to the implied maqūl al-qawl, and the clause «إنا معكم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فأتيا» is conjoined to the clause «اذهبا». The word «رسول» may be singular even if a dual or plural precedes it; you say: هو رسول، وهما رسول، وهم رسول (he is a messenger, they two are a messenger, they are a messenger). «العالمين» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause «أرسلْ» is explicative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «نربِّك»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping of the weak letter. «وليدًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf. The preposition «من عمرك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «سنين», and «سنين» is an adverb attached to «لبثت».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: «فعلتك»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «التي» is a naʿt (adjective). The clause «وأنت من الكافرين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «فعلت».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «إذًا» is a particle of response. The clause «وأنا من الضالين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the tāʾ in «فعلتها».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: (فوهب لي ربي حكما وجعلني من المرسلين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the two conjoined elements, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «من المرسلين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «وتلك نعمة» is conjoined to the preceding maqūl al-qawl (object of saying), and the clause «تمنُّها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «نعمة». «أنْ» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), namely the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. هل هناك إله غيري؟ (is there any god other than me?). «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «رب» is the khabar (predicate). The clause «وما رب العالمين» is conjoined to the implied maqūl al-qawl.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «رب»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هو رب. «وما»: a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الأرض». The clause «إن كنتم موقنين» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «حوله»: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). «ألا» is a particle of offer (ʿarḍ).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «ربكم»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هو رب.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective), and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) in the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «رب»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هو رب. The clause «إن كنتم تعقلون» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The lām in «لئن» paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam). «غيري» is the second object. The clause «لأجعلنَّك» is the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and the preposition «من المسجونين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: (أولو جئتك بشيء مبين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. أتفعل بي ذلك؟ (would you do that to me?). The clause «جئتك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the second-person pronoun in the implied maqūl al-qawl, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The implied maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is: إن كنت صادقا فأت (if you are truthful, then bring). So the fāʾ in «فأت» links the apodosis of an implied condition. The clause «إن كنت من الصادقين» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The clause «فألقى» is resumptive; the second fāʾ is a conjunction, and «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya); [then] a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate). The clause «فإذا هي ثعبان» is conjoined to the clause «فألقى عصاه».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: «فإذا»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya). The clause «فإذا هي بيضاء» is conjoined to the clause «نزع يده». The preposition «للناظرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second khabar (predicate), i.e. ظاهرة للناظرين (evident to the onlookers).

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The adverb «حوله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الملأ». «عليم» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إنَّ».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «يريد» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «ساحر», and the interpreted maṣdar is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The fāʾ in «فماذا» is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا» is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); and the clause «تأمرون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «أرجه»: an imperative verb from أَرْجَيْتَهُ, said when you have postponed it, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and giving sukūn to the hāʾ of the pronoun is a dialect usage. «أخاه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ. «حاشرين» is a mafʿūl bihi; it is originally an adjective of an omitted described noun, i.e. رجالا حاشرين (men who gather).

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «يأتوك»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), because it is the apodosis of an implied condition.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: (وقيل للناس هل أنتم مجتمعون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the maṣdar, and the clause «وقيل» is conjoined to the clause «جُمع».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «لعلنا نتبع» is resumptive; «هم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw. The clause «إن كانوا» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «فلما جاء السحرة» is resumptive. The clause «إن كنا» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «نحن» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun «نا».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. نعم إن لكم أجرًا (yes, you shall have a reward). The clause «وإنَّكم لمن المقربين» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl. «إذًا» is a particle of response, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «ما» is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the ṣila (relative clause) is nominal.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «فألقوا» is conjoined to the preceding clause {قَالَ لَهُمْ مُوسَى}. The preposition «بعزة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «نقسم» (we swear), and the clause «نقسم بعزة» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying). The clause «إنا لنحن الغالبون» is the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and the clause «لنحن الغالبون» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», in the position of the nominative.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «فإذا هي تلقف» is conjoined to the clause «ألقى موسى»; «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya); «ما» is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: «ساجدين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «السحرة». The clause «فألقي» is conjoined to the clause {فَأَلْقَى مُوسَى}.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «العالمين»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with yāʾ, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «أنْ» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «إنه لكبيركم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «فلسوف تعلمون» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying). The preposition «من خلاف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الأيدي والأرجل». «أجمعين» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the second-person pronoun. The implied oath clause and its response fill the place of the two objects of «علم», and the clause «ولأصلبنَّكم» is conjoined to the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The khabar (predicate) of «لا ضير» is omitted, i.e. علينا (upon us). The clause «إنا إلى ربنا منقلبون» is resumptive; the preposition «إلى ربنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «منقلبون».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «إنا نطمع» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The maṣdar «أن يغفر» is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ) (في), and the second interpreted maṣdar «أن كنا» is accusative by removal of the preposition, namely the lām.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «وأوحينا» is resumptive; «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya); the clause «إنكم متبعون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «فأرسل فرعون» is resumptive; «حاشرين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «قليلون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شرذمة». The clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) of an implied verb of saying, and the implied saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of {فِرْعَوْنُ}, i.e. أرسل يقول إنَّ ... (he sent, saying: indeed …).

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «وإنهم لنا لغائظون» is conjoined to the preceding clause, and the preposition «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «لغائظون».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The kāf is a preposition attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. إخراجنا كذلك (Our expelling [them] was thus), and the clause is resumptive. The clause «وأورثناها» is conjoined to the resumptive clause.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The clause «فأتبعوهم» is resumptive, and «مشرقين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «أتبعوهم».

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: (فلما تراءى الجمعان قال أصحاب موسى إنا لمدركون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. كلا لن يدركونا (no, they will not overtake us). The clause «سيهدين» is a second khabar (predicate): the sīn is for the future, [then] an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the dropped yāʾ, and the nūn is for protection (wiqāya).

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The clause «فأوحينا» is resumptive; «أنْ» is explicative (tafsīriyya). The clause «فانفلق» is conjoined to an implied conjoined clause, i.e. فضرب فانفلق (so he struck, and it split).

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «ثَمَّ» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) used to point to a distant place; it is not inflected, and it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أزلفنا». «الآخرين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وأزلفنا» is conjoined to the clause «أوحينا».

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The adverb «معه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); «أجمعين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of Moses and his people.

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The clause «وما كان أكثرهم» is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The clause «وإن ربك لهو العزيز» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً}; the clause «هو العزيز» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «الرحيم» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of {نَبَأَ}. «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «فنظل» is conjoined to the clause «نعبد»; the preposition «لها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عاكفين», which is the khabar (predicate) of «ظل».

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: «إذ» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. لم نجدها كذلك (we did not find them so). The clause «وجدنا» is resumptive. The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. يفعلون فِعْلا مثل ذلك الفعل (they do a doing like that doing). The clause «يفعلون» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. أتأملتم (have you considered?). The clause «رأيتم» is conjoined to the implied maqūl al-qawl. The second object of «أرأيت» is omitted, i.e. هل يستحق العبادة؟ (does it deserve worship?). «ما» is a relative noun, the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «أنتم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw in {تَعْبُدُونَ}; «آباؤكم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the wāw in {تَعْبُدُونَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: The clause «فإنهم عدو» is resumptive; the preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عدو», and the clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:78-78.t: «الذي» is a relative noun, a naʿt (adjective). The clause «فهو يهدين» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause). «يهدين» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ in «يهدي»; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:79-79.t: (والذي هو يطعمني ويسقين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The relative noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:80-80.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun {هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي}; «إذا» is an adverbial conditional particle (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the sense of the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:81-81.t: «يحيين»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:82-82.t: (والذي أطمع أن يغفر لي خطيئتي يوم الدين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ) «في». The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يغفر».

harrat-mujtaba:83-83.t: The clause «هَبْ» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. «رب»: a vocative (munādā) in a genitive construct, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:84-84.t: The preposition «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied second object; the preposition «في الآخرين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «لسان».

harrat-mujtaba:85-85.t: The preposition «من ورثة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:86-86.t: The clause «إنه كان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أبي».

harrat-mujtaba:87-87.t: The clause «يبعثون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:88-88.t: The adverb «يوم» is a badal (substitute) of the preceding {يَوْمَ}; the clause «لا ينفع» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «لا» is redundant (zāʾida). [Translator's note: so in the source; «لا» here is ordinarily negating.]

harrat-mujtaba:89-89.t: «مَنْ»: a relative noun, the excepted (mustathnā). The preposition «بقلب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «أتى», i.e. ملتبسًا (accompanied [by]).

harrat-mujtaba:90-90.t: The preposition «للمتقين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أزلفت», and the clause is conjoined to the clause {لا يَنْفَعُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:91-91.t: The clause «وبُرِّزَت» is conjoined to the clause «أزلفت».

harrat-mujtaba:92-92.t: «أين»: an interrogative noun, an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: so in the source; «ما» in «أين ما كنتم تعبدون» is usually parsed as a relative noun.]

harrat-mujtaba:93-93.t: The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied returning pronoun, i.e. تعبدونه كائنًا من دون الله (you worship it, being other than Allah). The interrogative clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:94-94.t: The clause «فكبكبوا» is resumptive; «هم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw; «والغاوون» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:96-96.t: The clause «وهم فيها يختصمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «قالوا»; the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يختصمون».

harrat-mujtaba:97-97.t: (تالله إن كنا لفي ضلال مبين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The tāʾ is for the oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an implied «أقسم» (I swear). «إنْ» is lightened from the heavy [form] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla) and inoperative (muhmala); [then] an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb and its noun; the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:98-98.t: «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) of kāna is attached, and the clause «نسوِّيكم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:99-99.t: The clause «وما أضلَّنا» is conjoined to the answer to the oath. «المجرمون» is the fāʿil (agent).

harrat-mujtaba:100-100.t: The clause is conjoined to the clause «ما أضلَّنا». «ما» is negating and inoperative (muhmala); «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «شافعين».

harrat-mujtaba:102-102.t: (فلو أن لنا كرة فنكون من المؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The interpreted maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of an implied ثبت. The fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. ليت لنا رجوعًا فكوننا من المؤمنين (would that we had a return, and our being among the believers). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. لَعَمِلْنا صالحا (we would have done righteous deeds).

harrat-mujtaba:103-103.t: (وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The negated clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:104-104.t: The clause «وإن ربك ...» is conjoined to {إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً}; «الرحيم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:106-106.t: «إذ» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كذَّبت»; «نوح» is a badal (substitute); «ألا» is a particle of offer (ʿarḍ).

harrat-mujtaba:108-108.t: The fāʾ in «فاتقوا» is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to the clause «إني رسول».

harrat-mujtaba:109-109.t: The negated clause is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida), and «أجر» is the second object. The clause «إن أجري ...» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; «إنْ» is negating, and «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:110-110.t: The clause «فاتقوا الله» is conjoined to the clause «ما أسألكم».

harrat-mujtaba:111-111.t: The clause «واتبعك الأرذلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «نؤمن».

harrat-mujtaba:112-112.t: The maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. أهم كذلك؟ (are they so?). The clause «وما علمي» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl; «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «علمي» is the khabar (predicate). [In] «بما», «ما» is a relative noun, genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (علمي).

harrat-mujtaba:113-113.t: The clause «إنْ حسابهم ...» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «لو تشعرون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. لَعلمتم أن حسابهم على ربي (you would know that their account rests with my Lord).

harrat-mujtaba:114-114.t: The negated clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلا عَلَى رَبِّي}; «ما» is negating and operates like laysa, and the bāʾ in the khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:115-115.t: «إنْ» is negating, «أنا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «إلا» is a restrictive particle, «نذير» is the khabar (predicate), and «مُبين» is its naʿt (adjective); the clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:116-116.t: The clause «يا نوح» is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa); the clause «لنكونن» is the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath; and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

harrat-mujtaba:117-117.t: «كذَّبون»: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:118-118.t: The fāʾ in «فافتح» is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to {كَذَّبُونِ}. «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the yāʾ; «معي» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); the preposition «من المؤمنين» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative noun.

harrat-mujtaba:119-119.t: The clause «فأنجيناه» is conjoined to the clause {قَالَ} in verse (117). The relative noun «مَنْ» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause); the preposition «في الفلك» is attached to the implied ṣila.

harrat-mujtaba:120-120.t: «بعد»: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, because it is cut off from the genitive construct.

harrat-mujtaba:121-121.t: (إن في ذلك لآية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The negated clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa), and the wāw is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:122-122.t: The clause «وإن ربك لهو العزيز» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً}.

harrat-mujtaba:124-124.t: «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) {كَذَّبَتْ}; the clause «قال» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «هود» is a badal (substitute).

harrat-mujtaba:125-125.t: The clause «إني لكم رسول» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رسول».

harrat-mujtaba:126-126.t: The clause «فاتقوا» is conjoined to the clause «إني رسول».

harrat-mujtaba:127-127.t: The clause «وما أسألكم» is conjoined to the clause «أطيعون». «من أجر» is the second object, and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «إن أجري» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:128-128.t: The clause «أتبنون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «تعبثون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تبنون».

harrat-mujtaba:130-130.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَتَتَّخِذُونَ}, and «جبارين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the tāʾ in «بطشتم».

harrat-mujtaba:131-131.t: The clause «فاتقوا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:133-133.t: The clause «أمدَّكم» is a badal (substitute) of the preceding {أَمَدَّكُمْ}.

harrat-mujtaba:135-135.t: The clause «إني أخاف» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:136-136.t: «سواء» is a fronted khabar (predicate); the preposition «علينا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «سواء». The hamza is the hamza of equivalence (taswiya), and «أم» is a conjunction; the hamza of equivalence and what follows it are equivalent to the mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied sense being: وَعْظُكَ وعدمه سواء (your admonishing and its absence are equal). The clause «أم لم تكن» is conjoined to the clause «أوعظت».

harrat-mujtaba:137-137.t: (إن هذا إلا خلق الأولين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:138-138.t: (وما نحن بمعذبين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «ما» operates like laysa, and the bāʾ in the khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida); the clause is conjoined to the resumptive clause before it.

harrat-mujtaba:139-139.t: The clause «فكذَّبوه» is resumptive, and the negated clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:140-140.t: (وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً}.

harrat-mujtaba:142-142.t: «إذ»: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) {كَذَّبَتْ}; «صالح» is a badal (substitute).

harrat-mujtaba:143-143.t: (إني لكم رسول أمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:144-144.t: The clause «فاتقوا» is conjoined to the clause {إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ}.

harrat-mujtaba:145-145.t: The first negated clause is conjoined to the clause «أطيعون»; «أجر» is the second object, and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). The second negated clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:146-146.t: The clause «تتركون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. «ما» is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تتركون». The «ها» in «هاهنا» is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and «هنا» is a demonstrative, an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). «آمنين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:147-147.t: (في جنات وعيون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition and its genitive noun is a badal (substitute) of the preposition and its genitive noun before it, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:148-148.t: The clause «طلعها هضيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «نخل».

harrat-mujtaba:149-149.t: «فارهين»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «تنحتون».

harrat-mujtaba:150-150.t: The clause «فاتقوا الله» is conjoined to the clause «اتقوا» in verse (144).

harrat-mujtaba:152-152.t: (الذين يفسدون في الأرض ولا يصلحون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The relative noun is a naʿt (adjective), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يفسدون».

harrat-mujtaba:153-153.t: (إنما أنت من المسحرين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:154-154.t: The negated clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying. «مثلنا» is a naʿt (adjective); «مثل» did not gain [definiteness] from the genitive construct because it is extremely vague. The fāʾ in «فأت» links the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. إن كنت صادقًا فَأْتِ (if you are truthful, then bring). The clause «إن كنت» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:155-155.t: The clause «لها شِرب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ناقة», and the clause «ولكم شرب» is conjoined to the clause «لها شرب»; the linking pronoun is implied, i.e. لكم شرب غير شربها (you have a share of drink other than hers).

harrat-mujtaba:156-156.t: The clause «ولا تمسوها» is conjoined to the clause {هَذِهِ نَاقَةٌ}. The fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), [then] an imperfect verb in the subjunctive by an implied «أن» after the fāʾ; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. لا يكن مَسٌّ فأخْذٌ (let there be no touching and then seizing). The kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:157-157.t: The clause «فعقروها» is resumptive, and «نادمين» is the khabar (predicate) of «أصبح».

harrat-mujtaba:158-158.t: The clause «فأخذهم العذاب» is conjoined to the clause {فَأَصْبَحُوا}, and the negated clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the two conjoined elements.

harrat-mujtaba:159-159.t: The clause «وإن ربك لهو العزيز» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً}.

harrat-mujtaba:161-161.t: «إذ»: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) {كَذَّبَتْ}; «لوط» is a badal (substitute).

harrat-mujtaba:162-162.t: (إني لكم رسول أمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:163-163.t: The clause «فاتقوا» is conjoined to the clause {إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ}.

harrat-mujtaba:164-164.t: «أجر» is the second object, and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). «إن» is negating, and the second negated clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:165-165.t: The clause «أتأتون» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The preposition «من العالمين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الذكران».

harrat-mujtaba:166-166.t: The preposition «من أزواجكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied returning pronoun. The clause «بل أنتم قوم» is resumptive; «عادون» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:167-167.t: The clause «يا لوط» is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the oath and its response; the clause «لَتكوننَّ» is the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:169-169.t: «أهلي»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the yāʾ in «نجني».

harrat-mujtaba:170-170.t: «أهله»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ; «أجمعين»: a tawkīd (emphasis), accusative with yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:171-171.t: The preposition «في الغابرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عجوزًا».

harrat-mujtaba:172-172.t: The clause «دمَّرْنا» is conjoined to the clause «نجيناه».

harrat-mujtaba:173-173.t: «مطرًا»: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); the [noun] specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. مطرهم (their rain).

harrat-mujtaba:174-174.t: (وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The negated clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa).

harrat-mujtaba:175-175.t: (وإن ربك لهو العزيز الرحيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً}, and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:177-177.t: «إذ»: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) {كَذَّبَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:178-178.t: (إني لكم رسول أمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:179-179.t: The clause «فاتقوا» is conjoined to the clause {إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ}.

harrat-mujtaba:180-180.t: «أجر»: the second object, and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida). The second negated clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:183-183.t: «أشياءهم» is the second object; «مفسدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:184-184.t: «الجبلَّة»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the kāf in «خلقكم»; «الأولين» is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:185-185.t: «إنما»: a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), having no governing effect.

harrat-mujtaba:186-186.t: «ما» is negating and inoperative (muhmala). «مثلنا» is a naʿt (adjective); it did not gain definiteness from the genitive construct because it is extremely vague. «إنْ» is lightened from the doubled [form] (mukhaffafa min al-mushaddada), and the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «ظنَّ». The clause «وإن نظنك» is conjoined to the clause «ما أنت إلا بشر».

harrat-mujtaba:187-187.t: The clause «فأسقط» is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The preposition «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كسفًا». The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:189-189.t: (فكذبوه فأخذهم عذاب يوم الظلة إنه كان عذاب يوم عظيم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause «إنه كان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «عذاب يوم الظلة».

harrat-mujtaba:190-190.t: (وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The negated clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa).

harrat-mujtaba:191-191.t: The clause «لهو العزيز» is the khabar (predicate) of inna.

harrat-mujtaba:193-193.t: The clause «نزل به الروح» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:194-194.t: (لتكون من المنذرين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The genitive maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {نَزَلَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:196-196.t: The clause «وإنه لفي زبر» is conjoined to the clause «إنه لتنزيل».

harrat-mujtaba:197-197.t: The wāw is a conjunction. The interpreted maṣdar is the noun of «يكن», and «آية» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آية». The clause «أولم يكن» is conjoined to the clause «إنه لفي زبر».

harrat-mujtaba:198-198.t: (ولو نزلناه على بعض الأعجمين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «لم يكن لهم آية».

harrat-mujtaba:199-199.t: The clause «ما كانوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the preposition «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مؤمنين».

harrat-mujtaba:200-200.t: (كذلك سلكناه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the implied sense is: سلكناه سَلْكًا مثلَ ذلك السلك (We inserted it with an inserting like that inserting). The clause «سلكناه» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:201-201.t: The clause «لا يؤمنون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of {الْمُجْرِمِينَ}; the clause «يروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative.

harrat-mujtaba:202-202.t: The clause «فيأتيهم» is conjoined to the clause {يَرَوْا}. «بغتة» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial). The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause «وهم لا يشعرون» is a ḥāl of the hāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:203-203.t: The clause «فيقولوا» is conjoined to the clause «يأتيهم».

harrat-mujtaba:204-204.t: The fāʾ is resumptive, and the clause «يستعجلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:205-205.t: The hamza is interrogative, and the fāʾ is resumptive. «سنين» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «متعناهم». This verb «أرأيت» and the verb «جَاءَهُمْ» compete (tanāzaʿa) for {مَا كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ}; the second, «جاءهم», was given the governing role, so it made «ما كانوا» nominative as the fāʿil (agent), and the first object of «أرأيت» is its omitted pronoun; the implied sense is: أفرأيت ما كانوا يوعدون ثم جاءهم ما كانوا يوعدون (have you seen what they were promised, then there came to them what they were promised). The clause «إنْ متَّعناهم» is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: لم يُغْنِ عنهم تمتعهم (their enjoyment would not avail them).

harrat-mujtaba:207-207.t: The clause «ما أغنى» is the second object of the preceding «أرأيت». «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed before «أغنى»; the second «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the maṣdar is the fāʿil (agent) of «أغنى».

harrat-mujtaba:208-208.t: The clause «وما أهلكنا» is resumptive; «قرية» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr). The preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «منذرون». The clause «لها منذرون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «قرية»; what permits the owner of the ḥāl to be indefinite is the preceding negation.

harrat-mujtaba:209-209.t: «ذكرى» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «لها».

harrat-mujtaba:210-210.t: The clause «وما تنزلت به» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:211-211.t: The clause «وما ينبغي» is conjoined to the clause «ما تنزلت به الشياطين».

harrat-mujtaba:212-212.t: (إنهم عن السمع لمعزولون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; the preposition «عن السمع» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «معزولون», and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:213-213.t: The clause «فلا تدع» is resumptive; «مع» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The fāʾ is causal (sababiyya), and the interpreted maṣdar from «أَنْ» and what follows it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. لا يكن منك دعوة فحصول عذاب لك (let there be no calling from you, and then punishment befalling you).

harrat-mujtaba:214-214.t: The clause «وأنذر» is conjoined to the clause «لا تَدْعُ».

harrat-mujtaba:215-215.t: The preposition «من المؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «اتبعك».

harrat-mujtaba:216-216.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَاخْفِضْ}, and the preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «بريء».

harrat-mujtaba:218-218.t: The relative noun is a second naʿt (adjective) of «العزيز»; «حين» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:219-219.t: «وتقلُّبك»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the kāf in {يَرَاكَ}, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «تقلُّبك».

harrat-mujtaba:220-220.t: (إنه هو السميع العليم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ; «العليم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:221-221.t: The interrogative noun «مَنْ» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تنزل»; it is not attached to «أنبئكم», because the interrogative has the right to the head of the sentence. The clause «تنزل» fills the place of the second and third objects of «أنبئكم», the verb being suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative. «تَنزلُ» is an imperfect verb from which one of its two tāʾs has been dropped for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:222-222.t: The clause «تَنزل» is a badal (substitute) of the first.

harrat-mujtaba:223-223.t: The clause «يلقون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الشياطين», and the clause «وأكثرهم كاذبون» is conjoined to the clause «يلقون».

harrat-mujtaba:224-224.t: The clause «والشعراء يتبعهم الغاوون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:225-225.t: (ألم تر أنهم في كل واد يهيمون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The maṣdar fills the place of the two objects of «رأى», and the clause is resumptive. The clause «يهيمون» is a khabar (predicate), and the preposition «في كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يهيمون».

harrat-mujtaba:226-226.t: (وأنهم يقولون ما لا يفعلون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The maṣdar is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding maṣdar; «ما» is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:227-227.t: «إلا» is for exception, and the relative noun is accusative as the excepted (mustathnā). «كثيرًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The preposition «من بعد ما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «انتصروا»; «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The wāw in «وسيعلم» is resumptive. «أي» is an interrogative noun, a mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governor is «ينقلبون»; it may not be governed by «يعلم», because the interrogative has the right to the head of the sentence, so what precedes it does not govern it. The clause «ينقلبون» fills the place of the two objects of «يعلم», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.
